cards.ex: A challenge is something difficult that tests you. You need effort or skill to deal with it.
exs: Speaking English with new clients is still a challenge.
Volume lashes were a big challenge at first.

src.t: There’s a challenge I think, especially if people make very loud public proclamations about things.

cards.ex: A proclamation is a loud, public statement about what you believe or what will happen.
exs: He made a big proclamation that he would never raise his prices.
Be careful with loud public proclamations.

src.t: There’s a challenge I think, especially if people make very loud public proclamations about things.

cards.ex: A hostage is a person who is held and not free to leave. Being a hostage to something means it controls you.
exs: Don't be a hostage to your old opinions.
I felt like a hostage to my phone.

src.t: You mentioned there about, you’re almost a hostage to the things that you used to say.

cards.ex: Used to talks about something that was true or happened often in the past, but not now.
exs: I used to work in an office.
She used to hate mornings.

src.t: You mentioned there about, you’re almost a hostage to the things that you used to say.

cards.ex: To update means to change something so it has the newest information.
exs: I update my price list every year.
Please update the app.

src.t: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.

cards.ex: To change your mind means to decide something different from what you decided or believed before.
exs: I wanted classic lashes, but I changed my mind.
It's okay to change your mind when you learn more.

src.t: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.

cards.ex: Hypocrisy is saying you believe one thing but doing the opposite.
exs: Telling clients to rest while I never rest is a bit of hypocrisy.
People hate hypocrisy.

src.t: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.

cards.ex: Perhaps means maybe. You are not sure, but it is possible.
exs: Perhaps she's stuck in traffic.
Perhaps we can try a softer curl.

src.t: The difference between me saying something in the past and saying something different now is perhaps I’ve learned, perhaps I’ve updated my beliefs.

cards.ex: A belief is something you think is true.
exs: My belief is that natural lashes look best.
His beliefs changed after he moved abroad.

cards.ex: Legitimate means fair, honest and acceptable, not fake.

src.t: But so few people do it in a legitimate way.
